settings.heading: A print laboratory in Napier.

settings.heading: Custom prints. No limits.
settings.lede: From a single transfer to a thousand garments — same quality, same speed, same direct line to a real person.

settings.body: Based in Napier, Hawke's Bay. Tracked NZ Post shipping NZ-wide. NZD pricing. A real person on every email.

settings.heading: Why DTF beats screen printing.
settings.lede: Direct to Film printing replaced screen printing for most custom jobs because it does what screen printing can't: full colour without setup fees, soft feel on any fabric, and a single-piece minimum.
